inlines.v: PAN'EL, noun 1. A square piece of board, or other piece somewhat similar inserted between other pieces; as the panel of a door. 2. A piece of parchment or schedule, containing the names of persons summoned by the sheriff. Hence more generally, 3. The whole jury. PAN'EL, verb transitive To form with panels; as, to panel a wainscot.
